description: This Java source file defines the PresetsPane class, a GUI component for managing preset engine configurations for different car models within the application. It creates a panel with preset options, each associated with specific engine types, and includes controls for setting engine type commands that prompt user confirmation before executing.

classes.name: PresetsPane
classes.description: A GUI panel that displays preset engine configurations for different car models and allows the user to select and set engine types.

classes.name: PresetsPane.SetEngineTypeCommandControl
classes.description: A control representing a button to set a specific engine type, which prompts user confirmation before sending a command.

methods.name: PresetsPane
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the presets panel with preset engine options.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Returns the main JPanel containing all preset control buttons.

methods.name: createButtonListener
methods.description: Creates an ActionListener that prompts the user for confirmation and sends the engine type command upon approval.
